mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (demand) over the past 6 months predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods following a sustained GDPC1 upward trend are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% in the next month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 2% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceed 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous upward trend in GDPC1 (demand) and downward movement in UNRATE (labor) predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in the next month
regime_hint: expanding labor market and growing demand
failure_condition: The interaction effect (e.g., joint t-statistic < 1.96) is not statistically significant over 20-day periods when both proxies move in expected directions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS rates predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS declines in late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 8% in the next month signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 8% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during UNRATE spikes above 8%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS rates predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases and FEDFUNDS decreases in the next month
failure_condition: The combined effect (e.g., joint t-statistic < 1.96) is not statistically significant over 60-day periods when both proxies decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in HOUST (demand) over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in periods following sustained HOUST increases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in RSAFS (demand) above 400,000 in the next month signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 400,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during RSAFS spikes above 400,000.
